inventory.scope: Database cache readback for target product
inventory.boundaryEnforced: Excludes observations whose keyword does not match candidate canonical name or verified alias before time-series construction.

inventory.scope: Fresh provider fetch before database admission
inventory.boundaryEnforced: Excludes remote observations with non-matching keywords before executeDemandObservationBatchImport and before admission to in-memory livePoints.

inventory.scope: CSV provider observation search and selection
inventory.boundaryEnforced: Replaces loose substring/word-overlap filter with strict candidate-scoped attribution, preventing cross-candidate row leakage across shared product IDs.

inventory.scope: Deduplication and merge of live and cached observations
inventory.boundaryEnforced: Ensures deduplication preserves candidate identity and query identity, preventing wrong-keyword cached rows from colliding with valid candidate points.
Fails closed with CACHED_UNVERIFIED and productAttributionValid=false if any observation fails candidate attribution.
